scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @skytrace/api" "npm run dev -w @skytrace/app"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/api && tsc -p packages/app
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @skytrace/app
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @skytrace/api
